day_shape: Netanyahu orders expanded IDF operations beyond Lebanon's Yellow Line with mass evacuation warnings, CENTCOM denies WSJ report of resumed Hormuz escorts while confirming 108 vessels redirected under Iran blockade, heavy Khamenei Arafah/Eid messaging cycle, US-Iran nuclear talks reported slowed.

threads.label: IDF expands Lebanon operations beyond Yellow Line
threads.summary: Netanyahu ordered the IDF to expand beyond the security zone in Lebanon, with the military moving past the April 17 ceasefire Yellow Line in response to Hezbollah drone attacks. IDF Arabic spokesperson Avichay Adraee issued mass evacuation warnings covering Nabatieh, Bekaa Valley villages and over a dozen southern towns.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and escort dispute
threads.summary: CENTCOM publicly denied Wall Street Journal reporting that the US Navy had resumed Project Freedom escorts in the Strait of Hormuz, while saying US forces have redirected 108 commercial vessels under the blockade against Iran as of May 26. Times of Israel reported British sailors aboard RFA Lyme Bay off Gibraltar await a mine-clearing deployment to the Strait still in doubt.

threads.label: US-Iran nuclear talks slow
threads.summary: Mediators told the Wall Street Journal that US-Iran negotiations slowed on Monday over the nuclear programme and financial relief, with Jerusalem Post reporting Iran may consider transferring its 60% enriched uranium to China. Times of Israel reported the US struck missile sites in Iran despite the ceasefire, citing defence of US troops.

threads.label: Khamenei Arafah/Hajj message cycle
threads.summary: Khamenei's office published a series of excerpts from the Supreme Leader's pilgrimage message declaring America will no longer have a safe point for bases in the region and predicting the end of the Zionist regime. IRIB and Defa Press carried extensive Day of Arafah supplication coverage from Tehran, Isfahan and Jamkaran, alongside Pezeshkian's Eid al-Adha message.

threads.label: Pezeshkian regional phone diplomacy
threads.summary: IRIB reported Eid al-Adha calls between Pezeshkian and the leaders of Oman, Qatar, Turkey and Tajikistan, with Pezeshkian telling Sheikh Tamim Iran is ready to reach a 'dignified framework' for ending the war. Deputy Foreign Minister Gharibaabadi said the Caspian Sea is guarded as part of strategic interests.

threads.label: Gaza tunnels and anti-Hamas militia
threads.summary: The IDF announced it dismantled approximately 11km of underground tunnel routes in the Beit Hanun area east of Gaza's Yellow Line over recent months. Hussam al-Astal, head of the anti-Hamas militia in Khan Younis, told Jerusalem Post that Hamas claims of defections were 'psychological war', while Shin Bet chief was reported meeting Mohammed Dahlan in the UAE.

threads.label: Iran cyber, internal repression and IRGC claims
threads.summary: Times of Israel reported Iran's judiciary suspended a presidential body after it ordered internet access restored, and Israeli researchers attributed an LA transit system breach to Iranian hackers, while Iran executed a man over alleged Mossad cooperation. The IRGC claimed downing an MQ-9 Reaper and firing at an F-35 and RQ-4, and Iran-backed group Handala published a bounty list targeting Israelis.
